newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES CLOSE MIXED IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES CLOSE MIXED IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Sixteen stocks fell, seven rose and six were flat in 32.6-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday with the WIG 20 index up 2.7 percent to 1,698.7 points.
In comparison with their main market fixing 27 stocks rose, one fell and one was flat.
The National Investment Fund NIF index rose 1.5 percent to 140.2 points in 2.7-million-zloty trade.
NFI units rose 0.7 percent to 141 zlotys in an 18.8-million-zloty turnover. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
